blocking_findings.reason: The green pull_request workflow used actions/checkout default merge-ref semantics. The v0.2 release adapter correctly reports the actual checked-out Git HEAD, but the generated QA artifact therefore binds the temporary PR merge commit rather than explicitly exercising the immutable PR-head release subject. This is acceptable software QA but not sufficient provenance for a later single-use physical authorization decision.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Run the same nonexecuting release audit and synthetic QA under a workflow that explicitly checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha (or github.sha for workflow_dispatch), asserts git rev-parse HEAD equals that expected release-subject SHA, and records that SHA in the preflight artifact.

requirements: explicitly checkout the immutable PR head SHA instead of the synthetic PR merge ref
assert actual git rev-parse HEAD equals the expected release-subject SHA
rerun the identical CP01R4 v0.2 nonexecuting audit and synthetic replay QA
regenerate the 16-member content package manifest and confirm the package digest remains content-consistent
freeze workflow run ID, workflow head SHA, actual checked-out SHA and artifact digest
repeat WP2 authorization review only after the head-bound QA is green

forbidden_inference: Green implementation QA is not a physical authorization.
A temporary PR merge-ref checkout is not an immutable release-subject binding.
A content package digest is not an operative authorization decision or grant.
No background existence, uniqueness, Fredholmness, stability, ghost freedom or response-rank claim follows.
